title: Start Right
subtitle: Your foundation as an online professional
summary: No degree, no experience, no capital needed. Set up your workspace, learn the core skills, and build the mindset that lasts.
quote: Nobody checks your diploma here; what you finish this week is the thing that counts.
outcome: You'll have a working setup and the foundational skills to apply with confidence.

doFirst.title: Check your equipment
doFirst.desc: Run the interactive Equipment Checker, see what you have, plan what to buy in ₱.

doFirst.title: Do your first micro-task
doFirst.desc: A real job you can do today with no client. It finishes as your first portfolio piece.

doFirst.title: Build your first documents
doFirst.desc: Learn the anatomy of a resume and a tracker, then write your own. No file to download.

doFirst.title: Pick a direction
doFirst.desc: Explore the niches so you know which lane you're heading toward.

closing: Finish one micro-task this week and you have something to send.

title: Get Hired
subtitle: Land your first client, systematically
summary: Build assets that get replies, source your own leads and score each one for red flags, track everything, and close the offer.
quote: You will not feel ready, so send the application anyway and let the interviews teach you.
outcome: You'll have a live pipeline of applications and the prep to convert interviews into offers.

doFirst.title: Learn to source work yourself
doFirst.desc: Search operators, reverse-sourcing, and a red-flag scorer, build your own pipeline, not a bookmark list.

doFirst.title: Show proof, not promises
doFirst.desc: No client yet? Do micro-tasks. Each one finishes as a portfolio piece you can send today.

doFirst.title: Run your own mock interview
doFirst.desc: Write an interview-coach prompt yourself, then practice against it until the answers are sharp.

doFirst.title: Track every application
doFirst.desc: A working pipeline with a follow-up radar. Most offers are lost to silence, not rejection.

doFirst.title: Negotiate with evidence
doFirst.desc: Know your worth and ask with proof, the VET and ASK methods do the heavy lifting.

closing: Most offers are lost to silence, so apply on a schedule and follow up on every one.

title: Deliver
subtitle: Impress your client and become reliable
summary: Onboard like a pro, systemize your work with SOPs and trackers, and communicate in a way that makes clients trust you with more.
quote: Your first week is an audition for the second one, and organisation is what it scores.
outcome: You'll run the work on written systems, which is the reason clients keep you and refer you.

doFirst.title: Write your own first-week plan
doFirst.desc: Learn what a first week must prove, then write the plan yourself.

doFirst.title: Learn any tool, fast
doFirst.desc: The transferable method for mastering software in a weekend, not a tutorial to follow.

doFirst.title: Learn to write SOPs
doFirst.desc: Document any process so well you never explain it twice. You write them; you own them.

doFirst.title: Build the trackers your role needs
doFirst.desc: Schema, formulas, and judgment, so you can build a tracker for anything.

doFirst.title: Communicate like a professional
doFirst.desc: Status updates, async etiquette, and managing expectations.

doFirst.title: Become indispensable
doFirst.desc: Stop waiting to be told. Anticipate what the client needs next and own the outcome, not the task, that's the person they can't replace.

closing: A professional runs on written systems; a hire runs on memory.

title: Level Up
subtitle: Where specialising starts paying
summary: Specialize into a high-value niche, automate the repetitive, learn a premium language, and raise your rate.
quote: Systemise anything you do twice, and hand the rest to a machine that does not get bored.
outcome: You'll own a niche and have the evidence to ask for a higher rate.

doFirst.title: Pick and master a niche
doFirst.desc: Curated learning per specialization in the Niche Learning Hub.

doFirst.title: Learn a premium language
doFirst.desc: Japanese, Korean, or Mandarin draws from a far thinner pool of candidates, and a thinner pool is what moves a rate. Here's where to learn.

doFirst.title: Automate the repetitive
doFirst.desc: Zapier, Make, and n8n flows for the work that repeats. AI-First lays out each tool and what it unlocks for a client.

doFirst.title: Build the advanced artifacts
doFirst.desc: Dashboards, decision frameworks, and pro SOPs, built by you, from the rules up.

doFirst.title: Teach it back
doFirst.desc: Teaching is how you find the gaps you can't see. It's the last step of mastery.

closing: Specialise in one lane, then raise the rate the evidence supports.

title: Own
subtitle: The career becomes yours; then it helps someone else's
summary: Go direct, get legit, and grow into an end-goal role. Then send the ladder back down. This is where employment ends and ownership begins.
quote: The platform succeeds when you no longer need it. So does every stage before this one.
outcome: You'll own client relationships, invoice as a registered professional, and carry a name people vouch for: the three assets no platform can revoke.

doFirst.title: Own your clients
doFirst.desc: Move from platform gigs to direct relationships, referrals, retainers, and rates you set.

doFirst.title: Get legit
doFirst.desc: BIR registration, the 8% option, your own benefits, and the payment rail that protects your rate.

doFirst.title: Aim at an end-goal role
doFirst.desc: GTM engineer, RevOps, fractional operator. The roles you grow into from any lane.

doFirst.title: Take it anywhere
doFirst.desc: Your clients travel with you. Some countries now issue visas for exactly what you've become.

doFirst.title: Give back
doFirst.desc: One pro-bono project, one beginner you unstick. The GIVE method: the ecosystem you feed feeds you.

closing: Build the things nobody can revoke: your skill, your client list, and the name people vouch for. Then hold the door for whoever is next.
